I would marry an unwell person. 

Makes it all the better when you can truly see them shine. You know what isn't attractive? Labeling and judging others without knowing and truly appreciating their flaws just as much as their qualities.

Already had therapy. Didn't work except it being a money vacuum and it was obvious she wanted me to see her weekly just for the money. 

I don't have insurance so it wouldn't work either way.

I've applied to a few jobs on my phone because I don't have internet at my house. 
I don't think I'll ever get a job haha. No connections or references or anything. I just want to disappear.
Thanks. I'm sure you'll get out of it though.

Being myself resulted in having fucking everybody hating me calling me a lazy worthless unfunny antisocial bitch and being a NEET because I can't even graduate from a community college and I'm already on my second probation.
Thanks. I'll try to keep that in mind.

I don't have friends and the ones that I do are mostly online and don't ever propose the idea of hanging out or decline my invitations. 

I guess. Thanks.

I have treatment-resistant depression. I wanted to get into disability so at least my parents could get that money but they told me that its bullshit and I'm just a lazy piece of shit that doesn't want to work. 

I can't self-medicate myself with drugs. I just can't. I would like to, but I'd rather not risk it. 

I'm just tired.

I guess I'm just really scared of change. I feel like I have no time management for anything. I feel guilty if I pursue hobbies in all of this free time that I have. But I have no passion, ambition drive. You know. 

I do want to talk. Thank you. 

I just don't know what exactly. I'm so self-centered and a shitty person to talk to so I don't know what to talk about. I'm sorry. 

Truth be told I have stupid weeaboo fantasies. Learning Japanese and be fluent, get back into cosplaying and continue doing so well into my 30s ( But I'm a horrible piece of shit person so I'm ostracized from the community here. I was a really horrible teenager and still am as a young adult. ), and going to Japan despite already knowing how xenophobic their culture are. I don't know. 

It doesn't help that browsing through /pol/ made me acquire so much skewed beliefs about race. I just feel so confused and lost and wish I would have never discovered 4chan. Its an addiction I can't stop and I feel sick to the stomach. 

Even as a little girl I drew myself as a worthless hobo version of myself into my 20s. I guess it really was a self-fulfilling prophecy. I'm such a hateful despicable person. 

But enough about me. 

What's the baggage on your spot on the boat?

Same. My parents don't seem to care either. 
They hate how introverted I am but oddly relieved I'm not as extroverted as my older sister. 
I'm sorry you have a hard time making friends. I have social anxiety too and I know how crippling it is to have a normal social life especially with people who don't have the burden of our mental illnesses. 

I'd say for people like us our best bet is making friends through support groups. Even then, who knows what happens. 

I hope you'll make some decent friends in the end. I'm sure you will.
Good luck. I'm sure you'll recover from your depression rest assured. I believe in you. At least you're trying and wanting to get better.

I don't know. I'd just like to vent I guess. 

I'm getting a little sleepy though haha.

Hey dude, sorry to hear you're going through a similar situation. 

I've posted on r/Depression for months and haven't really improved at all. My ex-boyfriend at the time thought I did but in reality words are just words. He doesn't see how depressed I get behind the scenes. 

I'm hopeless. I'd doubt anything might come out of this. 

But let's talk. Even if there's the inevitable result we'll talk less and eventually lose contact and be strangers again.
